evals.prompt: I'm building a STACK-X conference programme page with Canvas. I need a block for each session that shows: the time slot, the session title with an expand/collapse toggle, the speaker's name and organisation, outlined badges for type and hall, and a full abstract. Below the abstract, show the speaker's circular photo, name, job title, and a 'View profile' link. Output the block as an HTML snippet — no masthead, nav, or footer needed.
evals.expected_output: An HTML block using sit-badge (outlined), sit-divider, sit-link, sit-icon. Time slot uses sit:text-overline-md with sit:text-primary-default. Session title uses sit:text-heading-md sit:font-semibold. Body text uses sit:text-body-md. Text colours use sit:text-heading-default, sit:text-body-default, sit:text-body-subtle. Speaker avatar is 88x88px circular. No masthead/mainnav/footer.

assertions.description: Output includes sit-badge elements with the outlined attribute
Output includes sit-divider
Output includes sit-link for the View profile link
Time slot uses sit:text-overline-md
Session title uses sit:text-heading-md
Body text uses sit:text-body-md not sit:text-base
Does not use raw sit:text-base (wrong token)
Uses sit:text-primary-default for the time slot colour
Uses sit:text-heading-default for heading colour
Uses sit:text-body-subtle for secondary text
Speaker avatar has border-radius for circular style
Output does not include sit-masthead or sit-mainnav
Does not use wrong sit:text-color-* tokens

evals.prompt: I'm building an events website using Canvas web components. Can you give me a session listing item that shows an event talk's details? I need: the time of day as a small label, the talk title (with a collapse/expand chevron button), the presenter's name and their organisation, description text of the talk, tags for session type and venue, and a speaker card with their photo (circular), name, role, and a profile link.
evals.expected_output: An HTML block using Canvas components and correct typography tokens. Same requirements as eval 0 — correct semantic typography tokens, sit-badge with outlined, sit-divider at the bottom, sit-link for profile. No page chrome.

assertions.description: Output includes sit-badge elements with the outlined attribute
Output includes sit-divider
Body text uses sit:text-body-md not sit:text-base
Does not use raw sit:text-base (wrong token)
Does not use wrong sit:text-color-* pattern
Time slot uses sit:text-overline-md
Output does not include sit-masthead

evals.prompt: My conference site needs a programme listing page built with Canvas. On the left I want a filter sidebar with checkboxes for: programme type (Keynote, Panel Discussion, Presentation), session time (Morning, Afternoon), and event hall (Hall A, Hall B, Hall C). On the right, show session results — each one should be a full session detail block with the time slot, title, speaker byline, outlined category badges, description, and a speaker profile card with circular photo and profile link. Give me the HTML for both the filter sidebar and one session detail block.
evals.expected_output: HTML containing both a filter sidebar (using sit-checkbox-group and sit-checkbox) and a session detail block (sit-badge outlined, sit-divider, sit-link, correct typography tokens). No page chrome.

assertions.description: Filter sidebar uses sit-checkbox-group
Session detail uses sit-badge with outlined
Session detail has sit-divider
Body text uses sit:text-body-md not sit:text-base
Does not use raw sit:text-base
Profile link uses sit-link
Output does not include sit-masthead
